snippet.title: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Carmageddon: Rogue Shift, an action vehicular combat roguelite game developed by 34BigThings. Players will engage in all-out mayhem on the track to take out enemy vehicles, complete challenges, and unlock new content to continue the carnage. Make use of a variety of weapons, upgrade vehicles, and defeat bosses in Carmageddon: Rogue Shift, launching on February 6 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#IGN #gaming
